collections.title: The dossier
collections.blurb: The research dossier itself, converted from the PDF: every catalogue, prophecy ledger, and source register.

collections.title: Scripture
collections.blurb: The New Testament in the public-domain World English Bible, one file per book.

collections.title: Gospels outside the canon
collections.blurb: Gnostic, infancy, passion, and sayings gospels, plus the Gospel of Nicodemus and Tatian's Diatessaron.

collections.title: Church Fathers
collections.blurb: Ignatius, Clement, Papias, Justin, Irenaeus, Eusebius, Origen, and the Didache, in 19th-century public-domain translations.

collections.title: Ancient witnesses
collections.blurb: Non-Christian testimony: Josephus, Tacitus, Suetonius, Pliny, Lucian, the Talmud, Mara bar Serapion, Thallus and Phlegon.

collections.title: Legal and administrative documents
collections.blurb: Roman rescripts, edicts, inscriptions, and official correspondence that mention Christians or Jesus.

collections.title: Archaeology and artifacts
collections.blurb: Inscriptions, ossuaries, mosaics, buildings, and scientific studies of relics.

collections.title: Denominational and institutional statements
collections.blurb: How churches and movements describe Jesus in their own words.

collections.title: Gospel registry
collections.blurb: Fifty-two gospels and gospel-type texts with dates, manuscripts, ancient verdicts, and canonical status in each tradition.

collections.title: Reference cards
collections.blurb: One page per numbered entry in the dossier's register: what the source is, what the dossier says it supports, and where it is cited.
